rules.title: Santa Ana annual rent increase cap
rules.requirement: Your landlord can raise rent only once a year, by no more than the lesser of 3% or 80% of the CPI change. For September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 the maximum is 2.87%, and you can file a Tenant Petition if your increase is higher.
rules.key_value: lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 2.87% for 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31

rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you, such as nonpayment of rent, a lease violation, or owner move-in. For certain eviction reasons, the landlord may have to help pay your moving costs.
